svg.title: Жим штанги стоя из стоек — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing barbell overhead press out of a squat rack, front-three-quarter view. Each panel includes its own clearly visible pair of tall squat rack uprights, J-cups at collarbone height and wide floor feet. LEFT: full-body athlete stands inside rack with stable legs, hands shoulder-width gripping bar at collarbone height, at J-cups, ready to unrack. RIGHT: same standing position inside matching rack, bar pressed overhead with nearly straight arms, now well above empty visible J-cups. No seat. Keep rack uprights fully in respective half. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
